newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea steps in to slow won vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea steps in to slow won vs dlr.

text.p: The central bank of Korea intervened in the interbank market in afternoon trading on Monday to support the falling won versus the dollar, dealers said.
But the bank denied the action, as it routinely does.
Dealers said the central bank came in when the won fell to 844.50.
"Sentiment has been bullish towards the dollar due to expected import deals in the near future and fewer than expected export deals due to labour strikes," one trader said.
Traders said the local currency would fall further without central bank support.
The won is currently trading at 843.60/70.
